property_summary: For any caller and any timestamp/block where a call to fallback with exactly 10 ether succeeds and advances pastBlockTime, the reference C only drains its balance when block.number % 15 == 0 (so address(c).balance == 0 iff block.number % 15 == 0 immediately after the call); the mutant flips that condition and therefore for some block numbers the balance-drain outcome differs.
change_summary: Change the transfer condition to trigger when block.number % 15 != 0, altering when balance is drained and thus affecting observable state.
